name: Crocodile
title: Restore and reuse lost DON!! cards with this well-prepared control deck!
desc: This is a low-speed deck centered around the Leader effect, which lets you recover a DON!! card lost due to a DON!! –1 effect during your opponent's turn. Purple's defensive options, which gain strength at the cost of DON!! cards, combine with yellow's durability to make for an exceptionally robust deck. Use your preserved Life cards as a shield and throw down powerful high-cost cards to dominate the battlefield.
